3025-4279-6255--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
3025-4279-6255--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Bastion of Remembrance, Zahur and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Bastion of Remembrance trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Zahur ability, creating a tapped 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bastion of Remembrance triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

647-2023-4289-4518.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kor Skyfisher and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2511-4871-8168.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token with flying due to Draconic Visitor.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

654-2493-5531-5694-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
654-2493-5531-5694-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Archaeomancer and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Archaeomancer and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield
When the lands enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Resolve the Archaeomancer trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield
When the land(s) enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers that many times, untapping the land(s)
Repeat.
654-2493-5531-5694-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Archaeomancer and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

728-3249-5553-6006.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-5553-6006.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Enduring Vitality by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Greedy Freebooter, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Greedy Freebooter dies, it triggers, causing you to scry 1 and create a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Greedy Freebooter from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Greedy Freebooter from your graveyard by paying its casting cost.
Repeat.

1329-2178-3661-6495.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1329-2178-3661-6495.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Shield Sphere from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shield Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Shield Sphere.
When Shield Sphere dies, Emry triggers, untapping Emry.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
1329-2178-3661-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1011-2728-5686-6854.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
1011-2728-5686-6854.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
1011-2728-5686-6854.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Cast Fate Transfer by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Host of the Hereafter and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Host of the Hereafter trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat from step 4.

45-1978-3430-5793.description:
Activate Khalni Gem by tapping it, adding six mana due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Khalni Gem which is an artifact creature due to Bello. 
Repeat any number of times.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1430-1619-2719.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1430-1619-2719.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Mirror Image and Sakashima of a Thousand Faces each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Mirror Image trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1430-1619-2719.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

413-4381--5.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Grumgully.
When the persist creature enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

1618-2440-2806-5997.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Iraxxa
1618-2440-2806-5997.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Reality Strobe.
Reality Strobe triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Iraxxa triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Reality Strobe.
Repeat.
1618-2440-2806-5997.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Iraxxa. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

2713-3094-4659-6791-7344.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in your graveyard.
2713-3094-4659-6791-7344.description:
Cast Brilliance Unleashed by paying {4}{U}{R}. Choose its second mode, targeting any artifact card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's second ability by paying {1} due to Zirda and tapping it, targeting Brilliance Unleashed.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Lithoform Engine, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Lithoform Engine ability, copying Brilliance Unleashed, targeting Lithoform Engine.
Resolve the copy of Brilliance Unleashed, returning Lithoform Engine from your graveyard to the battlefield as a 3/3 Robot artifact creature.
Repeat from step 2.

2933-4013-4742-5798.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Drowner of Hope.
When Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate the Eldrazi Scions by tapping them, adding {2}.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite tapped Eldrazi Scion tokens, you may sacrifice them for infinite {C}, and then forego tapping or sacrificing subsequent Eldrazi Scions.

1069-3228-4742-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-3228-4742-5499.description:
Activate Mobilization by paying {2}{W}, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Soldier.
Activate the Soldier by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Repeat.

730-5256-7084.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Emeria Angel triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

2893-3875-5478-6168.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
When the basic land enters, Tireless Provisioner and Obuun trigger.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Obuun trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

141-4050-6933.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-4050-6933.description:
Cast Incarnation Technique by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Incarnation Technique.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Incarnation Technique, with the copy targeting Naru Meha
Resolve the Incarnation Technique copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1003-5220-5686-6900.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker
When Phyrexian Walker dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Cast Phyrexian Walker from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

813-2103-3378.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana available each turn to cast Capture of Jingzhou and Illusionist's Stratagem.
813-2103-3378.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Illusionist's Stratagem by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou and Illusionist's Stratagem from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

1987-4125-4276-4477.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
1987-4125-4276-4477.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Shipwreck Dowser and Greenwarden of Murasa.
When Shipwreck Dowser and Greenwarden of Murasa enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-4125-4276-4477.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

1170-3542-6065.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{W}{W}
1170-3542-6065.description:
Activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{W}{W}
Cast Skyblade's Boon by paying its mana cost, targeting Displacer Kitten
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Palinchron.
When Palinchron enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Resolve the Skyblade's Boon spell.
Activate Skyblade's Boon by paying {2}{W}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2232-2537-3604-4050.description:
Cast Ghalta by paying {5}{G}{G}{G}.
When Ghalta enters the battlefield, it, Cadric and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Ghalta trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield from your hand.
Resolve the Cadric trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Ghalta with haste.
When the Ghalta token enters the battlefield, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the nontoken Ghalta to your hand from the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Ghalta token, adding {1}.
Resolve the Ghalta token's trigger, putting Ghalta onto the battlefield from your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

353-2034-2054.manaNeeded: {2}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
353-2034-2054.notablePrerequisites: Your storm count is equal to or higher than five plus the number of times you've cast Aeve from the command zone this game.
353-2034-2054.description:
Cast Aeve from the command zone by paying {2}{G}{G}{G} plus commander tax, if applicable.
Aeve's storm ability triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of itself for each spell you've cast previously this turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar three times by sacrificing the nontoken Aeve and two Aeve tokens, adding six {C}.
Choose to have Aeve returned to the command zone from your graveyard.
Activate Urn of Godfire's first ability three times by paying {6}, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing an Aeve token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Aeve.
Repeat from step 1.

678-2438-2929.notablePrerequisites:
You have an enchantment creature card in hand.
You control at least six enchantments.
You have enough mana to cast the enchantment creature.
678-2438-2929.description:
Cast the enchantment creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Composer of Spring triggers.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the enchantment creature.
When the enchantment creature dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning the enchantment creature to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 3, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Composer of Spring trigger from step 2, putting the enchantment creature onto the battlefield from your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

313-1601-1636.notablePrerequisites:
Illuminor Szeras does not have summoning sickness.
You control another nontoken creature with mana value six or greater.
313-1601-1636.description:
Activate Illuminor Szeras by tapping it and sacrificing a nontoken creature with mana value six or greater, adding at least six {B}.
Cast Corpse Dance with buyback by paying {4}{B}, returning the creature with mana value six or greater from your graveyard to the battlefield, and returning Corpse Dance to your hand.
The creature enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

1103-1368-4015-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Rift Elemental, adding {R}.
Rift Elemental dies, triggering Titania's second ability, causing you to mill three cards.
Cast Rift Elemental from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {R} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard.
Repeat.

628-1887-2122-4050.notablePrerequisites: Mindless Automaton has an even number of +1/+1 counters on it.
628-1887-2122-4050.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton's second ability by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat step 1 until Mindless Automaton has zero +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Mindless Automaton, adding one mana of any color.
Mindless Automaton dies, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a total of six +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

1494-2207.notablePrerequisites:
Immaculate Magistrate does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least five Elves.
1494-2207.description:
Activate Immaculate Magistrate by tapping it, putting at least five +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours' ability by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
